releaseNotes:
- Redesigned the home screen with a premium iPad-inspired layout, refined typography, soft ambient gradients, and translucent panels.
- Added a featured app grid with real installed app icons and a dedicated searchable App Library.
- Restyled the floating glass dock with a centered translucent pill, improved spacing, and persistent favorite-app customization.
- Updated the version display and latest-version message to use the actual build version.
